title: North Vancouver Elite Walking Brewery Tour
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
All areas and surfaces are wheelchair accessible
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
policies: We can accommodate dietary restrictions such as vegetarian, vegan, gluten-free, etc. If you have dietary requirements, please indicate them when booking.
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: Come explore North Vancouver’s brewery scene with us! We’ll visit 5 local breweries, each with its own vibe and amazing craft beers. You’ll get 2 tasters at every stop, and a couple of spots will have tasty bites to pair with the brews. Along the way, we’ll dive into North Van’s history—from its shipbuilding roots to the vibrant community it is today. Expect great beer, good company, and maybe even a few fun surprises. This is a laid-back, local way to experience the best of North Van!
